The '''Karg brothers''' were three [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] that lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the brothers participated in a gladiatorial match in [[Darga the Hutt's palace|the palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], fighting against the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Zayda]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[RX-7246]] and a group of undercover [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents.
